## Features
Adds a configuration area to this plugin's own card on the sidebar's Plugins page, toggling every fe
ature module of this plugin.
| Feature | Description |

| session-id-copy | Copy-session-ID button in the Session header's utility group. |
| compact-button
| Compact-context button at the right end of the composer tool row's left group; runs `/compact`. |

| provider-label | Shows the currently selected provider to the left of the model selector. |

| open-dsh-folder | Adds an "Open dshHome folder" button next to "Open configuration file" at the t
